missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Статья' is the nominative subject. 'Эта' agrees in the feminine nominative, 'полезная' is the predicate adjective, and 'очень' intensifies it. A simple model.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Статью' is the accusative direct object of 'прочитал', with the feminine accusative ending. 'Эту' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'уже' marks completion.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Статьи' is genitive in the 'у + genitive' frame. The negative 'нет' then governs the genitive 'автора'. A pattern for an article lacking an author.
Strategic focus: Dative after благодаря. The preposition 'благодаря' governs the dative, so 'статье' is dative, naming the source of knowledge. A natural pattern for thanks to something.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after adjective. The adjective 'доволен' governs the instrumental, so 'статьёй' is the instrumental object of satisfaction. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В статье' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to mark the setting. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional, and 'много фактов' is a quantity with genitive plural.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Статьи' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, 'написаны' is a short passive participle, and 'хорошо' is the adverb. A plural model.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. 'Статей' is the genitive plural with a fleeting vowel, used after the quantity word 'много'. 'Научных' agrees in the genitive plural. A common academic pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after над. The preposition 'над' governs the instrumental, so 'статьями' is the instrumental plural, what the editor works on. 'Новыми' agrees in the same case.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Об статьях' uses the prepositional plural after 'об' to mark the topic. 'Этих' agrees in the prepositional plural. A model for discussing several texts.
